summary_en: Interim dividend raised ¥30→¥40/sh (includes ¥10 anniversary special); year-end dividend raised ¥31→¥41/sh. Annual FY2/27 total ¥81/sh vs. prior ¥61/sh. Effective March 2026 60th anniversary commemoration.
title_en: Notice of revision to dividend forecast (60th anniversary special dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Central Security and Safeguarding Co. announced on 7 July 2026 a revision to its FY2/27 (ending 28 February 2027) dividend forecast. The company marks its 60th anniversary in March 2026 and implemented this revision to commemorate the milestone and return value to shareholders. Interim dividend is raised from ¥30/sh to ¥40/sh, comprising ¥30/sh ordinary dividend and ¥10/sh 60th anniversary special dividend. Year-end dividend is raised from ¥31/sh to ¥41/sh (all ordinary). Full-year FY2/27 dividend thus increases from ¥61/sh to ¥81/sh total, a ¥20/sh lift versus the prior forecast (and ¥21/sh versus FY2/26 actual of ¥60/sh).
